description.en: OpenAI-compatible wafer-scale inference with a free tier of roughly 1M tokens/day (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B), no credit card required.
description.zh-Hans: OpenAI 兼容的晶圆级推理服务，免费层约 100 万 tokens/天（如 Llama 3.3 70B），无需信用卡。

detail.en: Cerebras hosts open LLMs on its wafer-scale hardware at very high throughput (up to ~2,000 tokens/s on some models) behind an OpenAI-compatible API. The free tier provides roughly 1M tokens/day shared per model, with per-model RPM/TPM/TPD limits and no credit card required; exceeding limits returns 429. Paid Developer tier offers ~10x higher limits. Check the official rate-limits doc for current values.
detail.zh-Hans: Cerebras 使用晶圆级芯片托管开源 LLM，吞吐极高（部分模型可达约 2,000 tokens/秒），提供 OpenAI 兼容接口。免费层每个模型每天约 100 万 tokens，并按模型设置 RPM/TPM/TPD 限速，无需信用卡；超限返回 429。付费 Developer 层限速约为免费层 10 倍。当前限速值以官方 rate-limits 文档为准。

provider.name: Cerebras
provider.desc: Ultra-fast OpenAI-compatible inference with a ~1M tokens/day free tier.
